$description: The Field Book — Hestia's livery as a contract. Nine tinctures are committed and untouchable; every later color is a tint or shade of one of them. The parity test fails any commit where src/css drifts from this file, and the contrast test recomputes every recorded ratio arithmetically.

hearth-white.$description: The ground: warm plaster. Pure white is never used.

parchment.$description: The raised surface: paper on the drafting table.

char.$description: The ink. Pure black is never used.

umber.$description: Dimmed ink and money-out — an expense is not an error.

ember.$description: Kiln-fired clay: actions and the one number that matters. A tenth of any view, no more.

ember-wash.$description: Ember's paper. Ink on this wash is ember-deep, never ember — ember on it is 4.14:1 and fails AA.

fern.$description: Growth and money-in. A signal, not a theme.

madder.$description: Failure only. An expense is umber; a failure is madder.

survey-blue.$description: Statutory authority and citations alone. Never decoration, never a chart series.

graphite.$description: The second ink: axis lines, secondary series, borders that mean something. Sits between char and umber on the same warm axis.

sandstone.$description: Deep paper: table stripes, skeleton base, pressed surfaces. A shade of parchment, not a new hue. Body text on it is char.

ember-deep.$description: Pressed and active ember; the sanctioned ink on ember-wash. Clears 7:1 on the ground.

fern-wash.$description: Positive ground: money-in confirmations, a hold verdict's field.

madder-wash.$description: Error ground. Reserved for failure, like its ink.

survey-wash.$description: The stamp's paper: citation chips only.

surface-2.$description: Role: deep paper — stripes, skeletons, pressed fills.

ink-2.$description: Role: the second ink — still AAA on both grounds.

ink-dim.$description: Role: secondary text. AA, not AAA — never below 13px without char.

ink-faint.$description: Role: tertiary text — AA on paper and parchment at any size (the axe gate proved 45% was a promise the app didn't keep); never on sandstone.

line.$description: Role: the drawn edge. Elevation is drawn, not filled.

line-soft.$description: Role: the faint rule — table rows, ruled paper.

money-out.$description: Role law: an expense is umber, never madder.

serif.$description: Bitter — the hearth's voice. The fallbacks share nothing with the consultancy's stacks.

sans.$value: var(--font-ui, "IBM Plex Sans"), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
sans.$description: IBM Plex Sans — dense UI text.

mono.$description: IBM Plex Mono — every figure is tabular ink.

type-display.$description: The largest voice on any page.

type-heading.$description: The wordmark's size; card group heads.

type-lead.$description: Lead paragraphs; the floor for emergency surfaces.

type-micro.$description: Pills and table headers. The smallest legal size.

type-stat.$description: The instrument readout: mono, tabular, slashed zero.

track-section.$description: Section-title tracking — the wide-set surveyor's stamp.

shadow-1.$description: Resting paper. Every shadow keeps its drawn hairline edge.

shadow-2.$description: Raised: an open disclosure, a held marker.

dur-4.$description: The draftsman's trace — once per mount, never on data updates.

dur-stagger.$description: Per-row delay when entries settle onto the page; cap the count at eight.

ease-settle.$description: A slight overshoot: things landing on the page.

$contrast.$description: WCAG 2.1 ratios, recorded here and recomputed by the contrast test on every run. Floors: 7 = AAA text, 4.5 = AA text, 3 = non-text UI.
